posts.text:
Yesterday (Sat Oct 31), Toronto streetcars spent 771 hours held up beyond a clean run.

Worst: 501 Queen westbound, a typical trip lost 40 min.
Smoothest: 512 St Clair eastbound, 11 min lost.

https://freems88.github.io/ttc-streetcar-delays/

Slowest segment yesterday: Bathurst St northbound approaching Fort York Blvd.
Each streetcar lost 135 s here on average, over 140 passes: 5.2 hours in all.
The signal here has transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of Bathurst St around Fort York Blvd, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the northbound segment at Fort York Blvd is highlighted, peaking at about 135 seconds lost per streetcar.
